title: review
description: Inline review findings, anchored by code snippet (not line number).

path.description: Repo-relative path of the file the comment is about.

snippet.description: A SINGLE verbatim line from the file — the most specific line the finding is about, never a multi-line block. The harness strips leading whitespace; internal whitespace must match. Escape double quotes as \" and there must be no raw newline.

context_before.description: Optional. The single line immediately before snippet, to disambiguate when snippet repeats. Same escaping rules.

context_after.description: Optional. The single line immediately after snippet; same role as context_before.

body.description: One short paragraph; cite the standard or reason. No headers.

severity.description: info = nit / maintainability / readability. warning = likely runtime bug. blocker = must fix before merge (exploitable security, data-loss risk, correctness bug certain to break production). Reserve warning for things that COULD CAUSE A RUNTIME PROBLEM; if you're tempted to label maintainability as warning, it's info.
